source: Prefill processes many prompt tokens together. Matrix dimensions are larger, there are many query rows, and optimized GEMMs/attention kernels can expose substantial reuse and parallelism. The computation often has more opportunity to amortize weight and activation movement across many operations.
zh: Prefill 一起处理许多提示标记。矩阵维度更大，有很多查询行，优化的 GEMM/注意力内核可以暴露大量的重用和并行性。 The computation often has more opportunity to amortize weight and activation movement across many operations.
